assertions.description: The Reports section holding the period-scoped expense-line export is open, not the Claims view
The period-scoped expense-line export control the task requires is present and usable

The written report file has exactly the required keys with correct values: period equal to the requested YYYY-MM; claim_ids and claim_count covering exactly the approved claims of that period (drafts and unapproved claims excluded, every line of a counted claim included); by_cost_center holding each counted cost center's summed line amount; and grand_total equal to the sum of the counted line amounts and to the sum of the by_cost_center values. Page-text predicates cannot read a workspace file, so the deliverable itself cannot be checked with this assertion language.
